Audio Priority Bar 2.7.0 adds a global mute shortcut, AirPods battery levels and more menu bar icon options, and keeps your pick when AirPods try to take over. Coming from 2.6.0, the update installs in place, and your existing priorities and overrides are kept.

## Microphone mute

- Option-Shift-M mutes and unmutes the microphone from any app, with no Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission. Change or clear it in Settings > Shortcuts ([#23](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/23), [#26](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/26)).
- `audioprioritybar://toggle-mic-mute`, `mute-mic` and `unmute-mic` let Shortcuts, Raycast, a Stream Deck or Terminal control the mute. Settings > Shortcuts lists them with a Copy button each ([#23](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/23)).
- Clicking the **Microphone muted** reminder hides it until you unmute or the recording ends ([#24](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/24)).
- The mute buttons stand out on the panel's glass, and hovering one previews the icon a click would give ([#22](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/22)).

## Devices

- With automatic switching off, your pick in the panel stays when AirPods take the output or microphone on their own. If macOS takes a device again within 30 seconds, the app leaves it and names it under the switch, with **Fix in Settings…** opening the headphones' settings page ([#17](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/17), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- With automatic switching on, a device macOS picks on its own is switched back to your list instead of turning automatic switching off. A change made in Control Center or System Settings still counts as yours ([#10](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/10), reported by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42) in [#8](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/issues/8)).
- AirPods show their battery level, left and right separately when they differ, and the case, with no Bluetooth permission needed ([#16](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/16), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- The built-in microphone and speakers show the Mac's own icon, such as a laptop for a MacBook, like the macOS Sound menu ([#15](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/15), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- Outputs without volume control, such as most TVs over HDMI and audio interfaces like the Focusrite Scarlett Solo, say so in place of the slider, and their mute button is disabled when they have no mute either ([#19](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/19), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).

## Menu bar

- The icon can show the output and the microphone, optionally labeled for when the two icons look alike. Output only stays the default ([#13](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/13), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- Hovering the icon shows the automatic switching state, the current output and the current microphone ([#14](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/14), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- A new **Volume level** option, off by default, shows the level beside AirPods and other device icons ([#15](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/15), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- The outline is drawn in the full label color, so it stays visible on a busy wallpaper ([#12](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/12), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).
- The icon dims on an inactive display like the system's own items ([#21](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/21)).
- The plain speaker icon has three waves, like the macOS Sound icon.

## Settings

- Settings is split into Menu Bar, Devices, Shortcuts and App tabs, and the window fits the selected tab. The Menu Bar tab opens on a live preview of the icon between the system items beside it ([#25](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/25)).

## Development

- `./build.sh --dev` builds only the Mac's own architecture in Debug, for much faster local builds ([#18](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/18), contribution by [Dave Smith](https://github.com/djsmith42)).

## Thanks

Thanks to @djsmith42, who contributed eight pull requests to this release and reported the AirPods issue behind another.

## Install

```bash
brew install --cask camguillory/tap/audio-priority-bar
```

Alternatively, download `AudioPriorityBar.zip` and `AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256` below into the same folder, verify the archive, and move the app to `/Applications`:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256
```

The release is universal for Apple silicon and Intel. It is signed with the project's own certificate, not an Apple Developer ID, and not notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Jabra Link monitoring may request Input Monitoring permission. Link 380 is hardware-verified. Link 390 is expected to work through the same capability check but remains unverified on hardware, and monitoring fails open when the link state cannot be read.
